title: feat(studio): customize a read-only package's view, dashboard or report into its <base>.custom pair, with an override badge and "Restore package original"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb7ALAiYy5ZTzr6TSya1KhXp)_

Fixes #28562

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 打开只读基础包（如 HotCRM）的视图、仪表板、报表，或对象条目的列表视图时，标题栏多一个「自定义」。点它只解锁编辑器，不写任何东西。第一次保存编辑时，每个条目调用一次 ensure 门（`POST /packages/:id/ensure-customization`）。之后把草稿写进门回答的配对包 `<base>.custom`，草稿声明 `overrides: { package, basedOn }`，`basedOn` 取包列表里基础包的 `manifest.version`。待发布数、变更面板和发布都改为作用于配对包。标题栏显示「覆盖 HotCRM」徽标，读自服务器返回的声明。⋯ 菜单新增「恢复软件包原版」：确认后先删草稿，再删配对包里的这一行，基础包的版本随即读回。只读标记不再把这三种类型链接到 Setup。
- **为什么改**：已安装包在 Studio 里只读，管理员想改 HotCRM 的列表列、仪表板或报表，又不想动 HotCRM 本身（ADR-0146 D2/D3）。
- **风险与回滚**：纯前端改动，只调用已上线的门：ensure、草稿保存、批量发布和删除。可写包的行为不变（有对照测试）。纯 revert 即可回滚。
- **先看**：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里 `InterfacesPillar` 的 `doSave`（配对包 id 取自门的回答）、`restoreOriginal`，以及 Studio 外壳里的 `draftScope` / `publishTarget`；新文件 `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.customize-28562.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.customizePublish-28562.test.tsx`，预期 19 例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，由席位落地。

## What changes

- **Customize** (`StudioCustomizeControls.tsx`, new) appears in the item header of a view, dashboard or report, and of an `object` leaf's list view, when the package is read-only. Pressing it only unlocks that item's editors (canvas, inspectors, list-view panel). Nothing is written until an edit is saved, so an unedited Customize leaves nothing behind.
- **First saved edit** (`InterfacesPillar` `doSave`, and the list-view hook's save via its new `customization` option). It calls `ensureCustomizationPackage` (`packages-io.ts`, new) once per item, with no prompt and no body. It then saves the draft into **the package the door's answer names**. The body is the item as held, without its top-level `_` keys, with `overrides: { package: <base>, basedOn: <listed manifest.version> }`. The answer is judged by the spec's `EnsureCustomizationPackageResponseSchema`. A declaration the item already carries is kept as it is. The first save into the pair is pinned `If-None-Match: *` when the buffer was read at the base, so a draft someone else left there is asked about, never overwritten.
- **Walled.** Under the `group` or `isolated` posture, an admin who is not the platform operator sees Customize disabled, with the reason. This is read from `features.tenancyPosture` and `user.isPlatformAdmin`, the facts `useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly` reads. Any refusal from the door is shown as the envelope reader writes it (`<sentence> (<CODE>)`), and nothing is saved.
- **No version, no guess.** A base whose listed manifest states no `version` gets Customize disabled, with a sentence that says so.
- **Pending, panel, Publish** (Studio surface). On a read-only base with a pair (the door's answer, else the pair the package list lists), the pending feed, `DraftChangesPanel` and `publishPackageDrafts` name the pair. A refusal at the publish door goes through the existing refusal path, verbatim. A read-only base with no pair keeps the read-only Publish and its reason.
- **Badge** (`StudioOverrideChip`). It reads the declaration the server serves: the pair's draft through the draft door, else the layered read's `overlay` (N-10). Its title names the version. It is never computed.
- **Restore package original** (`StudioRestoreOriginalItem` + `StudioRestoreOriginalDialog`) is on the ⋯ menu of an item served as an override. On confirm it sends `DELETE /meta/:type/:name?state=draft&package=<pair>`, then `DELETE /meta/:type/:name?package=<pair>`, and reloads the item. The base reads back. The pair is the door's answer this item's saves named, else the surface's. The door is not asked again.
- **`StudioReadOnlyLink`** no longer links a view, dashboard or report to Setup's overlay page. Other overlay-able types keep the link.
- **Strings.** Twelve `engine.studio.customize.*` keys in the studio namespace (en + zh). The placeholder is `{package}`, because the zh census refuses a bare Latin `base`.

### Surface additions (approved by the seat)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`. `useObjectListViewDraft` gains an optional `customization` (`readAt` / `writeTarget`), and `ObjectListViewInspector` gains `canCreate` (default `!readOnly`). Without them nothing changes.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` (new).

## Tests

- `StudioCustomizeControls.customize-28562.test.tsx` (36): type gate, declaration parse, override body (`_` keys dropped, an existing declaration kept, `null` with no version), the wall matrix, the ensure client (201 and 200, no body, refusal text, a malformed answer refused, `packages-changed` only on create), listed version and pair, and the button and badge.
- `InterfacesPillar.customize-28562.test.tsx` (13). The mounted pillar, real autosaves, and the real ensure client over a fetch stub that answers 201, then 200, are driven against a server double. Covered:
  - Customize writes nothing.
  - One ensure call per first edit, with the draft at the pair carrying the declaration and the base untouched.
  - A second item answered 200.
  - Pins: `If-None-Match: *`, then `If-Match`.
  - A refused door shown verbatim.
  - Walled disabled, and no version disabled.
  - No Setup link.
  - Restore on a dashboard (two deletes naming the pair, base label back) and Cancel.
  - The list view customized into the pair ("Add view" stays off).
  - Restore bringing back the base's columns.
  - CONTROL: a writable package saves in place with no door and no declaration.
- `StudioDesignSurface.customizePublish-28562.test.tsx` (6). The real surface and the real client over fetch. Covered:
  - Pending reads `_drafts?packageId=<pair>`, the panel reviews the pair, and Publish posts `/packages/<pair>/publish-drafts`.
  - End to end, from first edit to door to pair draft at the listed `4.0.0`, then Pending and Publish follow the pair.
  - No version disabled.
  - A group posture plus a non-operator is walled, and the platform operator is not.
  - CONTROL: no pair keeps the read-only Publish on the base.
- `StudioReadOnlyLink.overlay-27356.test.tsx` was updated. View, dashboard and report are plain. An overlay-able `email_template` still links (control).

### Ablations

Nineteen, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each one landed, its filtered test went red, and the file was restored to HEAD:

| # | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `pairFor` never reuses an answer | one ensure per first edit |
| A2 | save sends the body without the declaration | first saved edit |
| A3 | save writes at the base, not the pair | first saved edit |
| A4 | ensure keyed per base, not per item | second item gets 200 |
| A5 | `customizeDoorWalled` always false | walled admin (surface) |
| A19 | pillar ignores `walled` | walled caller (pillar) |
| A6 | `publishTarget = packageId` | Publish targets the pair |
| A7 | `draftScope = packageId` | Pending/panel on the pair |
| A8 | `publishReadOnly = readOnly` | Publish enabled on the pair |
| A9 | Restore skips the row delete | Restore brings back the base's columns |
| A10 | served overlay declaration ignored | badge on a served override |
| A11 | no `noVersion` block | no version disabled |
| A12 | `StudioReadOnlyLink` ignores the three types | no Setup link (3 cases) |
| A13 | `canCreate` not passed | "Add view" stays off |
| A14 | no `If-None-Match` pin (leaf) | pins |
| A15 | no `If-None-Match` pin (list view) | list view customize |
| A16 | `leafReadOnly` always false | Customize writes nothing |
| A17 | `basedOn` not read from the listed manifest | end to end at `4.0.0` |
| A18 | save uses the listed pair, not the door's answer | first saved edit |

## Live measure

This was measured on `pnpm dev:crm` (base `com.example.crm`, read-only, view `crm_lead.all`) through the server's doors with curl. The browser UI was not driven; the UI is covered by the tests above.

- `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.crm/ensure-customization` answered **201** with `created: true` on the first call and **200** with `created: false` after. `data.packageId` was `com.example.crm.custom`, and the UI takes the pair from that answer.
- `GET /api/v1/packages` served `com.example.crm` with `manifest.version` **`4.0.0`** and `writable: false`.
- `PUT /meta/view/crm_lead.all?mode=draft&package=com.example.crm.custom` (`If-None-Match: *`) answered 200. The draft read at the pair carried `overrides: { package: "com.example.crm", basedOn: "4.0.0" }`, and `_drafts?packageId=com.example.crm.custom` listed it.
- `POST /packages/com.example.crm.custom/publish-drafts` answered `published`, 1. Then `GET …/layers?package=com.example.crm` returned **`overlay.overrides` = the declaration** and `effective.label` "All leads (customized)".
- Restore: `DELETE …?state=draft&package=com.example.crm.custom` answered 200, then `DELETE …?package=com.example.crm.custom` answered 200. The layered read then returned `overlay` null and `effective.label` "All Leads", **the base read back**.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not here (per the card):** rail marks, filter, switcher fold, New (N-19), flows (N-18), translations and email templates (N-25), the rest of the link and the package-less write (N-16b), and migration (N-16a).
- **Deviations:**
  - The item tools (history, source) stay read-only on a read-only base, also while customizing.
  - "Add view" stays off on a read-only base. A new view would be a new item of the base, which is N-19.
  - A list view the server does not hold yet, such as an object's default view that was never created, offers no Customize.
  - A walled admin's Restore is not disabled ahead of time. The server's verdict is shown.
  - The `If-None-Match: *` pin on the first pair save is an addition.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (src + tests): exit 0 at `6674886524`.
- All 291 `views/studio-design` test files: green at `6674886524` (2108 tests). The 85 tests outside it that read the studio namespace: green at `4bff2978d7`. `packages/i18n` (94 files): green.
- The 34 derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`) ran at `0513534c9f`: 34 of 34 exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). `check:sdui-manifest`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` were re-run at `4bff2978d7`: exit 0. ESLint on the touched files reported 0 errors.
- Merged `origin/main` three times. The second merge brought #28668 (the card #28567) and the third brought #28669 (the card #28573); both merged clean. At the head `1ae8358eb7`: app-shell `type-check` exit 0; this card's four test files, #28573's two Studio and catalog test files, `packages/i18n` (94 files) and the zh wording census green; `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-dead-keys` exit 0. No parallel fix of this card is on main.
